verdict.rationale: A manual review queue with customer history, signals, and similar cases is a fair question for a fraud-prevention platform, but the evidence never documents one. The closest item is the MCP note that an AI system can be used for "reviewing decisions" through natural-language commands. That is an adjacent agent-tooling feature, not an analyst review queue with contextual case data. The remaining evidence covers order decisions, webhooks, and chargeback disputes.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently
